description: Suppresses repeated pulses within a configurable discard period. The first pulse passes through and starts a cooldown window during which subsequent pulses are dropped. Useful for debouncing noisy signals or rate-limiting pulse outputs.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Pulse signal. Only rising edges that arrive outside the discard period are forwarded.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Throttled pulse output. Mirrors the forwarded pulse shape.

config.name: Discard period
config.description: Cooldown window in seconds after forwarding a pulse. Pulses arriving during this window are dropped. Set to 0 to disable throttling.

state.name: Previous input state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the input to detect rising and falling edges.

state.name: Discarding
state.description: Whether the block is currently in the cooldown window.
